items.q: Lan ______ the road when a motorbike suddenly pulled out in front of her.
items.vi: Lan đang băng qua đường thì một chiếc xe máy bất ngờ lao ra trước mặt cô.
items.explanation: A longer action already in progress (crossing the road) that is interrupted by a sudden short action in the past simple (pulled out) takes the past continuous: was crossing; crossed would make the two actions happen one after the other, and the perfect forms do not fit a when interruption.

items.q: The doctor said Nam should eat smaller ______ at dinner if he wants to lose weight.
items.vi: Bác sĩ nói Nam nên ăn những khẩu phần nhỏ hơn vào bữa tối nếu muốn giảm cân.
items.explanation: A portion is the amount of food served to one person, so you can eat a smaller one; ingredients are what a dish is made of, a flavour is a taste and a recipe is a set of cooking instructions.

items.q: You should ______ an appointment with the dentist before the holiday starts.
items.vi: Bạn nên đặt lịch hẹn với nha sĩ trước khi kỳ nghỉ bắt đầu.
items.explanation: The verb that collocates with appointment is make: you make an appointment; do, take and put do not go with it.

items.q: The forum's rules are strict, so nobody can ______ posting rude comments for long.
items.vi: Quy định của diễn đàn rất nghiêm, nên không ai có thể đăng bình luận thô lỗ mà thoát được lâu.
items.explanation: Get away with something means to do something wrong without being punished; get on with is to continue, get round to is to finally find time for, and get down to is to start working seriously.

items.q: The doctor ______ treated my brother has just moved to a hospital in Hue.
items.vi: Vị bác sĩ đã chữa cho anh tôi vừa chuyển đến một bệnh viện ở Huế.
items.explanation: The relative pronoun is the subject of treated and refers to a person, so it must be who; whom is only an object, whose shows possession, and which is for things.

items.q: Since Grandma came home from hospital, everyone has been ______ around her so as not to upset her.
items.vi: Từ khi bà đi viện về, cả nhà ai cũng phải rón rén giữ ý quanh bà để không làm bà buồn.
items.explanation: To walk on eggshells is to be very careful not to offend or upset someone; walk on air means to be extremely happy, walk on thin ice is to be in a risky situation, and walk on water is to do the impossible.

items.q: You ______ a taxi from the airport; the hotel bus was free for all guests.
items.vi: Bạn đã không cần phải đi taxi từ sân bay; xe buýt của khách sạn miễn phí cho mọi khách.
items.explanation: Needn't have + past participle says that something was done although it was not necessary; can't have and must have express deductions about what happened, which do not fit here, and mustn't have is not used for a past deduction.

items.q: The waiter brought us the ______ so that we could choose what to order.
items.vi: Người phục vụ mang thực đơn ra để chúng tôi chọn món.
items.explanation: The menu is the list of dishes you choose from before ordering; a dish, a dessert and a snack are kinds of food, not something you choose from.

items.q: Nam looks tired because he ______ on the phone since eight o'clock this morning.
items.vi: Nam trông mệt mỏi vì cậu ấy nói chuyện điện thoại từ tám giờ sáng đến giờ.
items.explanation: An activity that started in the past and is still going on, with since and a visible result (he looks tired), takes the present perfect continuous: has been talking.

items.q: There were very ______ tourists on the beach in the early morning, so it was wonderfully peaceful.
items.vi: Sáng sớm trên bãi biển có rất ít khách du lịch, nên nơi đó yên bình tuyệt vời.
items.explanation: Tourists is a plural countable noun, so it takes few (almost none), and very can only go before few, not a few; little and a little are for uncountable nouns.

items.q: Remember to ______ a photo of your passport before you travel abroad.
items.vi: Nhớ chụp một tấm ảnh hộ chiếu của bạn trước khi đi nước ngoài nhé.
items.explanation: In English you take a photo; make, do and catch do not collocate with photo.

items.q: Bún bò Huế is a famous ______ of central Vietnam, which every visitor should try.
items.vi: Bún bò Huế là một đặc sản nổi tiếng của miền Trung Việt Nam mà du khách nào cũng nên thử.
items.explanation: A speciality is a food that a place is famous for; an ingredient is one part of a dish, a diet is what a person usually eats, and a flavour is a taste.

items.q: If I ______ my phone charger at home, I could show you the holiday photos now.
items.vi: Nếu tôi không để quên sạc điện thoại ở nhà thì giờ tôi có thể cho bạn xem ảnh kỳ nghỉ rồi.
items.explanation: This is a mixed conditional: a past condition (I left the charger at home) with a present result (I could show you now), so the if-clause takes the past perfect hadn't left.

items.q: Grandpa finds it hard to ______ all the new apps his grandchildren use.
items.vi: Ông thấy khó theo kịp tất cả những ứng dụng mới mà các cháu dùng.
items.explanation: Keep up with means to stay at the same level as something that is changing fast; keep on with is to continue, keep out of is to stay away from trouble, and keep away from is to avoid going near.

items.q: While I ______ the hotel website, the internet connection suddenly dropped.
items.vi: Trong lúc tôi đang xem trang web của khách sạn thì kết nối mạng bỗng nhiên bị mất.
items.explanation: A longer action in progress (while) that is interrupted by a short past action takes the past continuous: was checking.

items.q: The hotel, the rooms ______ all face the sea, is fully booked until August.
items.vi: Khách sạn đó, với các phòng đều hướng ra biển, đã kín chỗ cho đến tận tháng Tám.
items.explanation: When possession is expressed after the noun, a thing (the hotel) takes of which: the rooms of which = whose rooms; of whom is for people, whose must stand before the noun, and in which would mean the rooms are inside something.

items.q: The receptionist reminded us ______ our room keys before we left the hotel.
items.vi: Lễ tân nhắc chúng tôi nộp lại chìa khóa phòng trước khi rời khách sạn.
items.explanation: Remind somebody to do something takes the to-infinitive; the phrasal verb hand in means to give something to the person in charge.

items.q: My patience is beginning to ______ — the hostel Wi-Fi has stopped working for the third time today.
items.vi: Tôi bắt đầu hết kiên nhẫn rồi — Wi-Fi ở nhà nghỉ đã hỏng lần thứ ba trong ngày hôm nay.
items.explanation: When your patience wears thin, you gradually stop being able to put up with something; a joke falls flat, your mind goes blank, and your imagination runs wild.

items.q: The soup had a strong ______ of ginger, which really helped my sore throat.
items.vi: Món súp có vị gừng rất đậm, và điều đó thực sự giúp cổ họng đau của tôi dễ chịu hơn.
items.explanation: The flavour of a food is its particular taste; texture is how it feels in the mouth, appetite is the desire to eat, and a portion is the amount served.

items.q: My sister loves crowded night markets, ______ I prefer quiet cafés by the river.
items.vi: Chị tôi thích những khu chợ đêm đông đúc, trong khi tôi lại thích những quán cà phê yên tĩnh bên sông.
items.explanation: Whereas joins two clauses that contrast two different people or things; despite cannot be followed by a clause, so that gives a purpose, and otherwise means 'if not'.

items.q: Passengers ______ switch their phones to flight mode before the plane takes off; it is an airline rule.
items.vi: Hành khách phải chuyển điện thoại sang chế độ máy bay trước khi máy bay cất cánh; đó là quy định của hãng.
items.explanation: A rule or strong obligation is expressed with must; might and could only talk about possibility, and would is for hypothetical or repeated past actions.

items.q: Lan ______ a bad cold on the plane and spent the first two days of the holiday in bed.
items.vi: Lan bị cảm nặng trên máy bay và nằm giường suốt hai ngày đầu của kỳ nghỉ.
items.explanation: You catch a cold (or the flu); take, make and hold do not collocate with an illness.

items.q: ______ had we boarded the plane when the baby behind us started crying.
items.vi: Chúng tôi vừa mới lên máy bay thì em bé ngồi sau bắt đầu khóc.
items.explanation: Hardly + inverted past perfect pairs with when: Hardly had we boarded … when …; No sooner needs than, and Not until and Only when are followed by a clause before the inversion.

items.q: The doctor put Grandpa on a low-salt ______ after his blood pressure test.
items.vi: Sau khi đo huyết áp, bác sĩ cho ông theo chế độ ăn ít muối.
items.explanation: A diet is the kind of food a person regularly eats, especially for health reasons; a meal and a dish are single occasions of eating, and a menu is a list of food in a restaurant.

items.q: When we finally reached the gate, the plane ______ already.
items.vi: Khi cuối cùng chúng tôi tới được cửa ra máy bay thì máy bay đã cất cánh rồi.
items.explanation: The plane's departure happened before the past moment of reaching the gate, so the earlier action takes the past perfect: had left.
